question: What is the value of x, if (1/2) of 20 + (1/4) of 28 - (1/3) of x = 10?
solution:
Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/648c3294b25194c752df3d2220347abffcd6d6a931d733d69f041ba631062591.png] 

**Calculation:**

(1/2) of 20 + (1/4) of 28 - (1/3) of x = 10

⇒ 10 + 7 - x / 3 = 10

⇒ x / 3 = 7

⇒ x = 21

**∴ The correct option is 1**
